sections.advice: Manali → Atal Tunnel north portal is 23 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Atal Tunnel north portal → Baralacha La climbs about 4890 m in 56 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Baralacha La → Sarchu drops about 4890 m over 38 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Sarchu → Lachulung La climbs about 5059 m in 30 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Lachulung La → Tanglang La is 10 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Tanglang La → Leh drops about 5328 m over 134 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Leh–Manali Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 56 km this is Leh–Manali Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Manali-Leh Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: 4890 m come off over 91 km at around 13.0%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

scenicChapters.title: Leh–Manali Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 16.8%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.

scenicChapters.title: Leh–Manali Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 5328 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Tanglang La → Leh
scenicChapters.narrative: 327 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

leh-manali-highway.story: From Manāli it runs 708 km to Leh; allow about 10 h 05 of riding. It goes by way of Atal Tunnel north portal, Baralacha La, Sarchu and Lachulung La. The highest point is about 5,350 m. Baralacha La, Lachulung La and Tanglang La are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
